sentences.text: Today is the first hearing before me.
2. Learned APP for State has played the video clip of the suicide note recorded by the deceased immediately before committing suicide.
3. After watching the clip, learned counsel for accused/applicants, on instructions, seek permission to withdraw these anticipatory bail applications.
4. As requested, both these anticipatory bail applications are dismissed as withdrawn.
GIRISH KATHPALIA, J MARCH 28, 2026/as
